Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Single-Light Conical Pendant Light, 12.8"H, Matte Gray
Colors: Gray
The sleek conical pendant light is a subtly chic addition to any room. Its soft matte finish feels soothing before you even turn it on. With a long white cord, perfect placement is easy, allowing you to deliver bright, clear light to the spots that need it most. 10.5"W x 10.5"D x 12.8"H Metal shade with a matte finish A convenient long cord allows you to bring light and style wherever you need it. 1 60-watt E26 bulb required. Bulb not included. Expert installation required For indoor use only.
